title: StackHal Global Dev Tools MCP Specification
description: Formal contract definition for StackHal Developer & Infrastructure MCP tools exposed to AI agents.

tools.name: audit_website_seo
tools.description: Run a deterministic technical SEO audit for a public website URL.

tools.name: analyze_geo_readiness
tools.description: Analyze Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) signals and AI crawler readiness.

tools.name: inspect_domain_security
tools.description: Inspect domain email security and deliverability standards: DMARC (BIMI compliance), BIMI DNS & SVG reachability, MTA-STS (RFC 8461), SMTP TLS-RPT (RFC 8460), SPF and MX records.

tools.name: transpile_to_caddyfile
tools.description: Transpile Nginx (nginx.conf, server blocks) or Apache (.htaccess, VirtualHost) web server configuration to clean, idiomatic Caddyfile with migration advisories.

tools.name: inspect_apple_pkpass
tools.description: Inspect and validate Apple Wallet .pkpass JSON structure (pass.json) or package manifests: checks required keys, pass styles, dates, ISO 8601 timezones, transit types, barcodes, and color contrast.

tools.name: calculate_cidr_overlap
tools.description: Analyze IPv4/IPv6 CIDR subnets for range collisions, full containment, 2D bit-tree matrix partition, and available free subnet allocation.
